purpose: Select a lower-capacity controller using question-grouped train-only evidence, then permit at most one newly generated source-index-disjoint holdout evaluation.

claims_boundary.canonical_v0_2: immutable negative result; no file in its evidence bundle may be regenerated or replaced
claims_boundary.gsm8k_v2_validation: diagnosis-only after the published failure; prohibited for v3 fitting, selection, thresholds, or promotion
claims_boundary.gsm8k_official_test: prohibited for v3 fitting, selection, diagnosis, tuning, or evaluation
claims_boundary.capacity_screen: development evidence, not a confirmatory generalization claim
claims_boundary.fresh_holdout: confirmatory only if every capacity gate passes before generation

prior_execution_disclosure.description: An earlier bounded CPU runner completed the four small candidates on 20 folds but was interrupted during its 128-wide control and yielded no metrics or recoverable artifacts. Before this protocol freeze, the parent observed only candidate/fold progress, not any outcome.
prior_execution_disclosure.use: none; the capacity rerun specified below supersedes it and must be completely materialized before a decision
prior_execution_disclosure.difference: the rerun predeclares batch_size 2048 and omits the already-diagnosed 128-wide control

assignment.algorithm: sort ascending by (sha256(UTF8('branchpilot-v3-capacity-v1\0' + uid)).hexdigest(), uid), then assign sorted_position modulo 5

promotion_gate.pooled_mean_utility_delta: strictly positive at all three primary costs
promotion_gate.pooled_lower_95_bound: nonnegative at at least two of three primary costs
promotion_gate.worst_fold_mean_utility_delta: not below -0.01 for any primary cost

selection_if_multiple_pass: largest minimum pooled lower 95% utility bound across primary costs
largest mean pooled utility delta across primary costs
capacity_screen.no_go_rule: If no candidate passes, freeze an explicit NO-GO result and issue no fresh-holdout model requests.

fresh_holdout.authorization: only the selected capacity candidate passing every promotion gate
fresh_holdout.source_index_selection: exclude every source_index present in the immutable train and diagnosis-only validation rollouts; rank each remaining index by (sha256(UTF8('branchpilot-v3-holdout-v1\0' + decimal_index)).hexdigest(), index); select the first 500
artifact_freeze_before_generation: train selected configuration once on all 1600 immutable train rollouts
freeze agreement-2 comparator and all costs
commit protocol, capacity result, artifact metadata, source-index list, and hashes

evaluation.criterion: learned-minus-agreement-2 utility lower 95% bound strictly positive at two primary costs and nonnegative at the third
report_all: elapsed time, requests, tokens, and compute with units
every failed, aborted, missing, or excluded prompt

decision_semantics.capacity_pass: authorizes the one frozen fresh-holdout workflow but is not itself a success claim
decision_semantics.capacity_no_go: scientifically complete stopped outcome with zero fresh-holdout requests
decision_semantics.fresh_holdout_pass: supports only this model, dataset source split, parser, sampling configuration, and comparator
decision_semantics.fresh_holdout_fail: must be published as a complete negative result without candidate substitution
